metric_definitions.damage_score: (Raw HP damage minus remaining HP removed on player contact) divided by measured seconds. Negative scores are valid.
metric_definitions.total_damage: Raw damage minus contact penalty, over the measurement window.
metric_definitions.raw_dps: Actual HP damage divided by measured seconds, excluding overkill.
metric_definitions.average_dps_per_enemy: Raw HP damage divided by living-enemy seconds, including offscreen enemies.
metric_definitions.average_damage_score_per_enemy: Net damage after contact penalties divided by living-enemy seconds.

limitations: Same neutral Substitute training swarm as the preview, not full game waves.
Stationary invulnerable player; no items or run upgrades; one maximum/evolved move per trial.
Ability start/outgoing/critical/cooldown hooks and selected weather follow preview; passive ability tick/contact damage excluded.
Burn follows preview level-1 scaling; poison uses enemy maximum HP.
Trials use fixed time steps and seeded randomness; website playback uses variable frame timing.
